title.narrative: Final report

description.narrative: This report presents the key achievements of the “Synergies for peace in Burundi: Phase III” project, which aimed to contribute to reconciliation and to more accountable and inclusive governance for peacebuilding and development in Burundi. Coordinated by Interpeace, this initiative brought together five major actors from Burundi's civil society: CENAP, BLTP, ICB, ASSEMAJI-Jimbere, and AJEBUDI-YAGA. It was funded by Switzerland’s Peace and Human Rights Division (PHRD) and the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands (EKN) for a duration of 3 years. It ended in March 2025.
